verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official, Atlassian-owned MCP server is documented at github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server, so an agent can connect to Jira through a first-party MCP endpoint. However, that single probe is the only evidence: nothing describes setup, scope, or behavior. Missing for 10: documentation of connection and auth flow, the Jira tools/operations exposed, deployment model (hosted vs local), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
